round_trip_requirements: Preserve source_case_id and regime/case IDs exactly.
Preserve forecast probability and null abstention values exactly.
Preserve proposal and target sampling probabilities and derived importance weights.
Preserve decision-profile costs, residual impacts, deferral costs and thresholds exactly.
Preserve reviewer fallback action separately from candidate output.
Preserve event threshold, horizon, units and strict exceedance semantics.
Preserve reliability/resolution bin boundaries and all decomposition terms.
Preserve every policy cost, regret/value denominator, profile and regime dimension.
Preserve the pinned NRES-010 Git blob SHA and source case count; every NRES-011 row must match its source scenario and forecast fields exactly.
limitations: NRES-011 reuses NRES-010's public synthetic cases and is not independent confirmation.
Decision costs are normalized fictional units, not actual money or resource allocations.
The perfect-information policy is an unattainable lower bound.
Relative economic value is profile-specific and undefined if the climatology/perfect-information denominator is non-positive.
The fixed-bin Murphy decomposition is a finite-sample diagnostic and can be biased; it is not a corrected unbiased estimator.
The public fixture does not establish causal benefit or real-world savings.
